notes: Each value is (English fraction) - (target fraction) of top-1 logit-lens predictions, averaged over prompts of the given prompt language and over CoT tokens. For phases the fraction is also averaged over the layers in the phase (layer-level gap); for individual layers it is a single layer (token-level gap). The English-vs-English gap is identically zero. Punctuation / special / out-of-class top-1 predictions contribute zero to every language, so each gap lies in [-1, 1].
